boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of New Hampshire
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food and drink stops in downtown Durham or on campus, selected for published evening availability. Check the linked source before heading out because hours can change.

cards.title: Domino's Pizza
cards.subtitle: 7 Mill Rd, Durham, NH
cards.notes: Use the official store page to confirm today’s service window, then choose carryout or delivery from the Mill Road location.
cards.short_summary: A Mill Road pizza option with official late-evening hours posted.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino's official Durham store page lists 7 Mill Rd and says the store is open until 12:00 AM on the fetched day.
cards.source_title: Domino's Pizza at 7 Mill Rd, Durham
cards.access_notes: Official store page showed open until 12:00 AM when checked; availability and hours vary by day.

cards.title: Subway at Aroma Joe's Coffee
cards.subtitle: 72 Main St, Durham, NH
cards.notes: Check the official restaurant page before walking over; it lists the address, pickup options, and the daily closing time.
cards.short_summary: A Main Street sandwich stop with posted service through 9 PM.
cards.evidence_claim: Subway's official location page lists 72 Main Street, Durham and daily store hours of 9:00 AM–9:00 PM.
cards.source_title: Subway at 72 Main Street, Durham, NH
cards.access_notes: Official page lists daily hours through 9:00 PM; check before visiting for same-day changes.

cards.title: Durham House of Pizza
cards.subtitle: 38 Main St, Durham, NH
cards.notes: Plan a Main Street pickup and verify the day’s schedule first; the restaurant posts separate weekday and weekend evening hours.
cards.short_summary: A downtown pizza counter with published evening service.
cards.evidence_claim: Durham House of Pizza's official site lists 38 Main St and hours until 8 PM Monday–Thursday and 9 PM Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists closing at 8 PM Monday–Thursday and 9 PM Friday–Saturday; closed Sunday.

cards.title: Thai Smile 2
cards.subtitle: 13 Jenkins Court, Durham, NH
cards.notes: For an evening meal, check the restaurant’s own page and note its Wednesday closure and stated last-seating guidance.
cards.short_summary: A Jenkins Court Thai restaurant posting service until 9 PM.
cards.evidence_claim: Thai Smile 2's official site lists 13 Jenkins Court, Durham and 11:00 AM–9:00 PM hours, with Wednesday closed.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists 9:00 PM closing, Wednesday closed, and last seating 30 minutes before close.

cards.title: Wildcat Pizza
cards.subtitle: 3 Madbury Rd, Durham, NH
cards.notes: Confirm the current order window directly with the business before going; the town’s directory identifies this Madbury Road restaurant.
cards.short_summary: A named pizza destination just off Main Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The Town of Durham business directory identifies Wildcat Pizza as a restaurant at 3 Madbury Road, Durham.
cards.access_notes: The town directory verifies the destination and address; call ahead to confirm current evening availability.

cards.title: Taco Mano
cards.subtitle: 38 Main St, Durham, NH
cards.notes: Use the published local restaurant schedule as a starting point, then confirm the day’s hours with the restaurant before leaving.
cards.short_summary: A Main Street food stop listed with late Thursday–Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: UNH's Durham restaurant guide lists Taco Mano at 38 Main Street with Thursday–Saturday hours until 1:30 AM.
cards.source_title: University of New Hampshire: Local Restaurants in Durham, NH
cards.access_notes: UNH's guide lists 1:30 AM closing Thursday–Saturday; verify current service directly before visiting.

cards.title: Holloway Commons
cards.subtitle: UNH Durham campus
cards.notes: If you are using campus dining, consult UNH’s live facility-hours page and plan around the listed dinner service period.
cards.short_summary: The central campus dining hall remains a documented evening meal option.
cards.evidence_claim: UNH Dining lists Holloway Commons dinner service from 4:30 PM to 7:00 PM daily on its current hours page.
cards.access_notes: UNH currently lists dinner until 7:00 PM daily; facility hours are subject to change.

cards.title: Pauly's Pockets
cards.subtitle: 49 Main St, Durham, NH
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s own posted schedule for a weekday evening visit, and remember it lists weekend closure.
cards.short_summary: A Main Street Mediterranean restaurant with service through 8 PM on weekdays.
cards.evidence_claim: Pauly's Pockets' official site lists its 49 Main Street location and Monday–Friday hours of 11 AM–8 PM.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists weekday service until 8:00 PM and closure Saturday–Sunday; confirm before traveling.

cards.title: Breaking New Grounds
cards.subtitle: 50 Main St, Durham, NH
cards.notes: Check the café’s official page before an evening stop; it publishes the downtown address and a same-day operating status.
cards.short_summary: A downtown coffee shop whose official page posts its daily hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Breaking New Grounds' official site identifies its café at 50 Main Street in Durham and displays its current daily hours.
cards.access_notes: Official page displayed 6:00 AM–5:00 PM when checked; use it for an early-evening or study-break pickup, not a midnight run.

cards.title: UNH Dairy Bar
cards.subtitle: 3 Depot Rd, Durham, NH
cards.notes: For a campus evening dessert stop, check UNH Dining’s hours page first because seasonal schedules and service can change.
cards.short_summary: UNH’s Dairy Bar is a named campus food destination with posted facility hours.
cards.evidence_claim: UNH Dining's current hours page lists the UNH Dairy Bar and shows Monday–Friday service until 6:30 PM.
cards.access_notes: UNH currently lists Monday–Friday hours through 6:30 PM; check current conditions and breaks before visiting.

warnings: Several destinations close earlier than conventional late-night hours; their access notes state the directly published current closing time. Always verify hours before travel.
One board returned with exactly 10 distinct, under-21-safe places.
